records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our net sales of $301.1 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2025 increased $9.8 million, or 3.4%, from our net sales of $291.2 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have seen sales volume stabilize for snack nuts, trail mix and snack bars while sales volume for recipe nuts has continued to decline given higher prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have remained agile by proactively identifying risks, modifying inventory plans and diversifying our supplier base to mitigate risk of customer order shortages and maintain our supply chain.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have continued to see higher selling prices at retail, with price increases starting to moderate for some products, including snack nuts and trail mix, and decrease for other products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Due to the factors discussed above, income from operations was $19.4 million, or 6.4% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2025 compared to $27.6 million, or 9.5% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2024.
